lab.statsIntro: Descriptive statistics, quartiles, histogram and linear regression. Separate values with commas, spaces or semicolons.
lab.solverIntro: Finds a root of f(x) = 0 with the bisection, Newton-Raphson or secant method.

lab.unitsIntro: 13 physical categories with instant conversion and a full table.
lab.ntIntro: GCD/LCM, combinatorics, primality, base conversion and 32-bit bitwise operations.

it.subtitle: Networking, bits & bytes and developer conversions

desc.network: IPv4 and IPv6 subnet calculator: network address, broadcast, mask, wildcard, host range and subnetting.
desc.bases: Convert between binary, octal, decimal and hexadecimal, see the weight of every bit (2ⁿ) and read the value as a BYTE, WORD, DWORD or QWORD.
desc.data: Convert sizes between bits, bytes, decimal multiples (kB, MB, GB — base 1000) and binary multiples (KiB, MiB, GiB — base 1024), and estimate transfer time.
desc.text: Encode text as UTF-8 hexadecimal, binary, decimal, Base64 and URL — or decode it back.
desc.time: Convert Unix timestamps (seconds or milliseconds since 1970-01-01 UTC) to dates and back.
desc.color: Convert colors between HEX, RGB, HSL and decimal, with the WCAG contrast against white and black.
desc.chmod: Convert Unix permissions between octal (755) and symbolic (rwxr-xr-x) notation.
